newsitem.title: USA: Key Energy to buy Ram Oil, Rowland Trucking.
newsitem.headline: Key Energy to buy Ram Oil, Rowland Trucking.

text.p: Key Energy Group Inc said Friday it signed a letter of intent to acquire Ram Oil Well Service Inc and Rowland Trucking Co Inc for about $17.6 million, consisting of $23 million in cash, less approximately $5.4 million in working capital.

Based in Hobbs, N.M., Ram/Rowland operate a fleet of 17 well service rigs, 93 fluid hauling and other trucks, 290 frac and other tanks, three disposal and brine wells, and dirt construction equipment including bulldozers, backhoes, front-end loaders, and motor graders out of four yards in the Permian Basin of Southeast New Mexico.

The operations are expected to contribute annualized revenues of about $24 million based on recent historical levels of revenues. Management believes that the combination of the Ram/Rowland operations with Key's Cobra Industries operation will make the combined operations the largest well service provider in Southeast New Mexico in terms of revenues and equipment, Key said.
Completion of the transaction is subject to the negotiation of a definitive agreement, the company's standard due diligence and any regulatory approvals.
